title: Ctrl+K anywhere
text: A modal command search with a configurable shortcut, shown with Kbd, and focus restored on close.

title: Fuzzy and highlighted
text: Subsequence matching over labels and keywords; matched characters are marked with text nodes.

title: Sections and pages
text: Recent commands, groups, and nested pages: Enter opens a sub-list, Backspace goes back.

title: Async providers
text: Server searches are debounced and aborted on each keystroke, with a loading state.

title: Virtualized results
text: Thousands of commands stay fast; the listbox keeps focus in the field with aria-activedescendant.
